PTHR45569_GO0000155.scope_reason: Holds for every full-length member carrying the transmitter region; the truncated and split members are listed as exceptions.

member_exceptions.exception_reason: At 370 residues it lacks the C-terminal histidine-kinase transmitter region (residues 670-883 in E. coli KdpD) that the activity requires.

A 379-residue split KdpD carrying only the N-terminal KdpD sensor region and a UspA domain; the kinase transmitter is encoded by the adjacent gene, so this protein does not itself have sensor-kinase activity.

supported_by.supporting_text: suggesting that the functional state of KdpD is at least a dimer and that the kinase reaction is a result of a trans-phosphorylation between two monomers.
